description: KoSIT XRechnung visualization, stage 2: xrechnung-html.xsl (XSLT 2.0, lang=de) renders an xr:invoice as a self-contained HTML page, reading its CSS and JavaScript with unparsed-text() and its labels from l10n/de.xml. The sources are stage 1's outputs: run sh bench/xrechnung-stage1.sh first, which writes them to bench/.cache/xrechnung-xr/ (xrechnung-xr checks that stage against Saxon). Output method is html, so normalise is whitespace (indentation differs). xsltproc is omitted: the stylesheet is XSLT 2.0. The stylesheet is version 2.0 and states no html-version, whose default XSLT 3.0 §26 leaves implementation-defined: Saxon serializes as HTML5 and writes <!DOCTYPE HTML>, go-xml as HTML 4 without one, so the strip removes that line.
